_what: Tokens priced on this chain that have no Chainlink feed on it. Recorded as a file because a missing artifact and a measured absence look identical in a directory listing, and only one of them is a finding.

absent.finding: no feed named 'Robinhood AMC / USD' in the directory
no feed named 'Robinhood RDDT / USD' in the directory

note: Seven of the nine tokens this project measures depth for have a feed on this chain; two do not. code/verify_feed_staleness.py exits 3 for those two rather than 0, because the absence of a feed and a feed that never went stale must not share an exit code.
what_this_does_not_establish: that AMC and RDDT are unpriced. They may be priced by something that is not a Chainlink feed on this chain; this records only that the directory names no feed for them.
that the directory is complete. It is the data source behind the vendor's own documentation page, which is rendered client-side and cannot be read directly.
